title: Snoop Dogg Reveals Sade Is His Dream Collaboration
htmlContent:
There aren't many people who can make Snoop Dogg nervous, but he laughed his way through a story about attending a Sade concert.

Recently, TMZ shared a video from Snoop and his friends in his studio in Inglewood, California. While they smoked and chatted, Snoop remembered when he was fortunate enough to meet Sade.

“I went to her concert; I went to see her perform on time,” he remembered. “I went with Heavy D and LL Cool J. She had all these visual effects where she disappeared and she was in the top of the sky. She was [amazing].”

“They were like, ‘You wanna go meet her?’ I was like, ‘Uh uh,'” he said to laughter. “I was too nervous!”

Snoop jokingly tried to leave because “there would be a lotta cars trying to get out” Snoop revealed that "Your Love is King” is his favorite Sade song. [Let’s] put a bat signal in the air,” in terms of a possible collaboration.

He reiterated that on Clubhouse in the Behind The Vest with Druski room.

He was asked about his dream collaboration, and Snoop answered, 'Sade. ' "I want some s*** that is timeless. I want some greatness.

I love her been loving her since she first started making music. So. I just feel like that's the level, I want to be at if I want to do something with somebody."

A hip-hop artist followed that up that he hasn't worked with that he would like to work with. Snoop said he was good on that.

Snoop Dogg is gearing up to release his new album ‘BACC ON DEATH ROW’  next month. The album will be dropping on Def Jam Records.
